# NSRC eMitter (web edition)

Published issues of the North Shore Radio Club of Illinois (NS9RC) newsletter. https://ns9rc.org

**This repo is generated. Do not edit files here by hand.** It is built from the private working repo (`nsrc-newsletter`) with `python3 -I scripts/build.py`, then committed and pushed. It is public because GitHub Pages serves it; only finished, published issues belong here. Never commit drafts, planning notes, member lists, or personal email addresses.

Hosting: GitHub Pages, deploy from the `main` branch root (`.nojekyll` is present; there is no Jekyll build).
